why: First turn with an advantage that is not the whole match (ADR 0046). Every run until now labelled each of a match's hundreds of decisions with that match's own outcome, so the pivotal cast and the forced one carried the same +-1 and no grouping of the action rows could recover a per-step signal that was never in the target. `value_lambda` 0.95 keeps almost all of the return's information and cuts the variance that comes from the tail of a 30-round match; watch `advantageStd` fall and then watch the win rate, never `r2`, which is expected to read worse by construction (ADR 0045 is the standing warning). The baseline is search-4, and it is a bar now rather than a remark: ci-69 scores 0.5325 against it with an interval that includes one half, and 0.725 against Greedy where search-4 scores 0.930, so the matchups are not transitive and one opponent does not describe an agent. Teacher stays search-4 until something beats it. Open: whether 0.95 is the right place on the lambda, whether the (kind, spell) middle of ADR 0045 behaves differently now that the target is not the whole match, and whether a discount below 1.0 adds anything the lambda has not.
